positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Migrated on-premise assets to the cloud using Java, Google Cloud Storage, and Hibernate with potential savings of $1M annually
- Enhanced legacy image application using Java, IM4Java (ImageMagick Library), Python, and JMS to be able to process 50k+ more assets within the system
- Defined a new workflow for a legacy image application using Java, IM4Java (ImageMagick Library), Python, and JMS which helped onboard 50+ new vendors onto the Macy's platform.
- Refactored existing upload service using Java and Python going from a 1-1 model to a 1-many model for the macys.com website
- Implemented system enhancements and fixed production bugs using Java, Hibernate, JSP, and JavaScript to help maintain system uptime at 99%

positions.title: Production Support Engineer
positions.description:
- Troubleshooted production issues using Splunk and SQL to increase accessibility and usability for up to 200 end users
- Developed an automated reporting service using Java, Apache POI, and JDBC  allowing 30-40 business owners to make better decisions for revenue generation
- Scripted a pricing history report using SQL that was used by business partners in a legal matter regarding pricing practices saving the company $100k+ in litigation costs

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed application for a technology investment dealing with omnichannel incentive and customer centricity.

Created a program to automate the process of migrating information from an old version of JIRA to a newer version of JIRA. Used Selenium, Firebug and XPather to accomplish my goal
